sintoma: NOC-4701: mesa Gi1/0/12 caiu; usuário ligou um hub com 2 notebooks. Porta vermelha no painel.
cli_output:
SW# show interfaces Gi1/0/12 status
Port      Name       Status         Vlan Duplex Speed
Gi1/0/12  MESA-12    err-disabled   40   auto   auto

SW# show port-security interface Gi1/0/12
Port Security              : Enabled
Port Status                : Secure-shutdown
Violation Mode             : Shutdown
Maximum MAC Addresses      : 1
Total MAC Addresses        : 1
Configured MAC Addresses   : 0
Sticky MAC Addresses       : 1
Last Source Address:Vlan   : aabb.cc00.0202:40
Security Violation Count   : 1

SW# show port-security address | include Gi1/0/12
AABB.CC00.0101   1   Gi1/0/12   Sticky

Log: %PM-4-ERR_DISABLE: psecure-violation error detected on Gi1/0/12
alternativas: Falta de OSPF area 0
RA Guard no uplink
Port-security violation (max 1 / sticky) — hub com MAC extra → err-disabled
DHCP snooping trust ausente no core fiber
explicacao_profunda: Secure-shutdown, psecure-violation e max 1 com sticky do primeiro MAC explicam o err-disabled ao aparecer o segundo. Remova o hub, limpe sticky se precisar e reative a porta. Não é OSPF nem RA Guard.

sintoma: NOC-4702: após habilitar DHCP snooping, VLAN 40 inteira em APIPA. Server em VLAN 10 via uplink Gi1/0/1.
cli_output:
SW# show ip dhcp snooping
Switch DHCP snooping is enabled
DHCP snooping is configured on following VLANs: 40
DHCP snooping is operational on following VLANs: 40

SW# show ip dhcp snooping | begin Interface
Interface        Trusted    Rate limit (pps)
----------------  -------    ----------------
GigabitEthernet1/0/1   no         unlimited
GigabitEthernet1/0/10  no         unlimited
GigabitEthernet1/0/11  no         unlimited

SW# show run interface Gi1/0/1
 description UPLINK-DIST
 switchport mode trunk
 (no ip dhcp snooping trust)

PC> ipconfig → 169.254.x.x
DHCP server 10.10.10.53 reachable from Dist (offers generated)
alternativas: Port-security max 1 em todas as mesas
Uplink sem ip dhcp snooping trust — Offers legítimos tratados como untrusted/drop
DAI rate-limit apenas
Voice vlan ausente
explicacao_profunda: Snooping on com Trusted no no uplink é o erro clássico: clientes sem IP. Configure trust em Gi1/0/1. Port-sec e voice não explicam APIPA em massa pós-snooping.

cli_output:

AA:BB:CC:00:11:01   10.40.0.50       84200       dhcp-snooping  40    Gi1/0/20
(no entry for 10.40.0.88)

SW# show ip arp inspection vlan 40
Source Mac Validation      : Disabled
Destination Mac Validation : Disabled
IP Address Validation      : Disabled
Vlan     Configuration    Operation   ACL Match    Static ACL
----     -------------    ---------   ---------    ----------
40       Enabled          Active

SW# show ip arp inspection statistics vlan 40
Vlan      Forwarded        Dropped
----      ---------        -------
40        120              340

SW# show run interface Gi1/0/22
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 40
 (host static .88 — no dhcp)

SW# show run | include arp inspection trust
ip arp inspection trust  (only on Gi1/0/1 uplink)
alternativas: Porta do host deveria ser dhcp snooping trust (incorreto para access tipicamente)
Remover DAI do uplink trust
Problema de CRC na fibra do ISP
DAI dropa ARP do estático sem binding — criar static binding ou usar DHCP / ajustar inspeção
explicacao_profunda: Drops altos e binding sem .88 com host estático explicam ARP dropado pelo DAI. DHCP clients com binding funcionam. Adicione binding estático ou mude para DHCP. Não confie a access do host.

sintoma: NOC-4704: hosts dual-stack perderam default IPv6 após 'hardening'. Router legítimo em Gi1/0/1.
cli_output:
SW# show run | section raguard|nd raguard
ipv6 nd raguard policy HOST
 device-role host
ipv6 nd raguard policy ROUTER
 device-role router

SW# show run interface Gi1/0/10
 description PC-USER
 switchport mode access
 ipv6 nd raguard attach-policy HOST

SW# show run interface Gi1/0/1
 description UPLINK-TO-ROUTER
 switchport mode trunk
 ipv6 nd raguard attach-policy HOST

Before: hosts had GUA via SLAAC from FE80::1 on router
After: no RA seen by hosts; Fe80 default missing
PCAP on access: no RA from router; RA from rogue laptop on Gi1/0/15 dropped (good)
alternativas: Policy HOST no uplink do router bloqueia RA legítimo — usar policy ROUTER/trusted no Gi1/0/1; HOST só no access
Port-security max 1 causa perda de RA
DHCP snooping trust no PC resolve SLAAC
DAI desliga IPv6 automaticamente
explicacao_profunda: RA Guard HOST no uplink do router dropa o RA legítimo e quebra SLAAC, embora também bloqueie rogue (bom no access). Mova ROUTER policy para Gi1/0/1. Port-sec e DAI não substituem o papel do RA.

sintoma: NOC-4705: após violação, porta err-disabled. Hub removido; precisa voltar ao ar com max 2 e sticky limpo.
cli_output:
SW# show interfaces Gi1/0/12 status
Gi1/0/12  MESA-12  err-disabled  40  auto auto

SW# show port-security interface Gi1/0/12 | include Status|Maximum|Sticky|Violation
Port Status                : Secure-shutdown
Violation Mode             : Shutdown
Maximum MAC Addresses      : 1
Sticky MAC Addresses       : 1

SW# show run interface Gi1/0/12
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/12
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 40
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security mac-address sticky
 switchport port-security mac-address sticky aabb.cc00.0101
 switchport port-security maximum 1
 switchport port-security violation shutdown

Ops: user now has PC + IP phone (two MACs expected)
alternativas: Apenas reload do core
Aumentar maximum para 2, limpar sticky antigo se necessário, no shutdown (ou recovery) na porta
Remover port-security e configurar OSPF na access
ip dhcp snooping trust na mesa do usuário
explicacao_profunda: Recovery exige corrigir a política (max 2 para phone+PC), limpar sticky obsoleto e reativar a interface. Reload do core e trust na mesa são incorretos. OSPF na access não substitui port-sec.
